cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: Its scientific name is Oddium wanderus. It is said to cover distances as far as 1,000 feet when night falls, walking on its two roots.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.description: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.description: The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then starts scattering allergenic, poisonous pollen.

cards.name: Lotad
cards.description: The leaf on its head is naturally dirt repellent and will stay clean even after transporting Pokémon that are covered in mud.

cards.name: Lombre
cards.description: It prefers waterfronts with plentiful food. It became nocturnal so it wouldn't have to compete for food with bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.description: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

cards.name: Genesect
cards.description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

cards.name: Nymble
cards.description: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

cards.name: Lokix
cards.description: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: The flame on its tail shows the strength of its life-force. If Charmander is weak, the flame also burns weakly.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: When it swings its burning tail, the temperature around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its opponents.

cards.name: Moltres
cards.description: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.description: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.description: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.description: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

cards.name: Charcadet
cards.description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

cards.name: Ceruledge
cards.description: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

cards.name: Seel
cards.description: The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.description: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's colder.

cards.name: Swinub
cards.description: It searches for food by digging into the ground with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn't give it any trouble.

cards.name: Piloswine
cards.description: Covered by a shaggy coat, it is resistant to the cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

cards.name: Mamoswine
cards.description: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.description: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.description: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees in half with a single hit.

cards.name: Yamper
cards.description: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

cards.name: Boltund
cards.description: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.description: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

cards.name: Pawmo
cards.description: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

cards.name: Pawmot
cards.description: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

cards.name: Misdreavus
cards.description: This Pokémon startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.description: In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls eagerly in order to hide its fear from its opponent.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.description: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it desperately flails its limbs about in an attempt to repel its opponent.

cards.name: Cresselia
cards.description: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

cards.name: Milcery
cards.description: The more sweet aromas it absorbs, the more its body swells. Milcery will deflate when its energy level drops.

cards.name: Alcremie
cards.description: Desserts that Alcremie have decorated with their cream have a rich, sweet flavor and bring happiness to all who eat them.

cards.name: Zacian
cards.description: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

cards.name: Bramblin
cards.description: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

cards.name: Brambleghast
cards.description: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

cards.name: Paldean Tauros
cards.description: This Pokémon has a muscular body and excels at close-quarters combat. It uses its short horns to strike the opponent's weak spots.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.description: It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.description: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It patiently awaits prey inside its funnel- shaped nest.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.description: Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, emitting ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.description: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.description: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.description: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

cards.name: Sableye
cards.description: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.description: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.description: It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks. It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey with venomous fangs.

cards.name: Absol
cards.description: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.description: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.description: Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see even in the dead of night. They live in groups of a few individuals.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.description: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.description: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.description: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

cards.name: Eternatus
cards.description: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.description: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

cards.name: Duraludon
cards.description: Duraludon's body is comprised of a special metal that's lightweight and scratch resistant. It's also smooth, as though it was given a mirror finish.

cards.name: Archaludon
cards.description: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

cards.name: Aipom
cards.description: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.description: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

cards.name: Smeargle
cards.description: Once a Smeargle reaches adulthood, it will have other members of its species leave paw prints on its back.

cards.name: Zigzagoon
cards.description: A Pokémon with abundant curiosity. It shows an interest in everything, so it always zigzags.

cards.name: Linoone
cards.description: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.description: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

cards.name: Ludicolo
cards.description: There are structures throughout its whole body that produce energy when hit by sound waves with a cheerful rhythm.

cards.name: Nymble
cards.description: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.description: It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during the day, then looks for food at night when it's colder.

cards.name: Piplup

cards.name: Yamper

cards.name: Zacian
cards.description: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.description: Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.description: It's dangerous for Wooper to travel alone. They line up in groups of three or four and help each other as they walk around the wetlands.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.description: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.description: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.description: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.
